build._doc: Wrap every *.json in src/data/ as a globalThis.PORTAL_DATA[<key>] companion (data-*.json.js). Engine: front-data-json-js-wrapper.sh.
Ship the wrapped data-*.json.js companions to dist/ root, so HTML can load them with <script src="data-<KEY>.json.js"></script> — no fetch, no CORS.

#1919: the engine tsc mod only type-checks (it discards everything but a named output), so dist/scripts/main.js was never produced and index.html loaded a 404. Bundle the ES module entry for the browser.
Inject navigator.serviceWorker.register(...) before </head>. MUST run BEFORE esbuild_sw so the modified HTML feeds into BUILD_HASH.

Inject single-namespace observability SDK (Sentry/OpenObserve-style). Mirrors console.* + errors + SW lifecycle to OPFS console.log. window.consoleLogs.{captureException, captureMessage, addBreadcrumb, read, readJSON, tail, clear, download}.
MUST run last — hashes the dist artifacts above to derive BUILD_HASH and inject it into the SW bundle.
